nusmp.page.book_fire.mereoleona_brachium: Calidus Brachium Barrage (灼熱腕 連撃) - with the Mana Zone read, the flames of her fist come at the target from every side: four blasts in 16 ticks, 5 base damage each to everything within 2.4 blocks of it, burning them. Mereoleona's fist style.
nusmp.page.book_fire.mereoleona_purgator: Calidus Brachium Purgatory (灼熱腕 煉獄) - she becomes the flame. For 20 seconds: Strength II, fire immunity and a ring of fire that burns up to 8 foes within 3.5 blocks for 3 base damage every second.

Calidus Brachium Purgatory: Abyss (灼熱腕 煉獄・深淵) - the deeper form. A shock of flame throws everything within 7 blocks back for 14 base damage, then 15 seconds of Strength III, Speed I and a wider, hotter ring (4.5 blocks, 5 base damage a second).
nusmp.page.book_fire.mereoleona_hellfire: Hellfire Incarnate (業火の化身) - her whole body turns to mana and flame. An eruption within 9 blocks (20 base damage, burning 8 seconds, thrown back), then 12 seconds of Strength III, Speed II, absorption and a ring of 6 blocks that burns up to 8 foes for 6 base damage a second.
nusmp.page.book_fire.leopold_deep_spiral: Deep Spiral Flame (深炎螺旋焔) - spirals of flame leave him in four directions at once, 9 blocks each: up to 8 foes burn and take 10 base damage. Leopold's own formula from the Heart Kingdom.
nusmp.page.book_fire.leopold_crimson_eru: True Flame Magic: Crimson Eruption (真炎魔法「紅蓮噴火」) - a formula is written over 7 blocks of ground where you aim; a second later the whole circle erupts: 22 base damage to up to 8 foes, burning 6 seconds, thrown up.
nusmp.page.book_plant.mimosa_magic_flowe: Magic Flower Cannon - a giant flower opens in front of you and fires a laser of pure mana up to 24 blocks: 14 base damage to up to 8 foes on the line, pushed back.
nusmp.page.book_plant.mimosa_dream_heali: Dream-Healing Flower Cradle - a cradle of vines and flowers closes round the ally you look at (or you): four pulses of 12 percent of their maximum health in 1.6 seconds and poison and wither taken out. The healing law still applies.
nusmp.page.book_plant.mimosa_princess_he: Princess-Healing Flower Robe - a robe of flowers on the ally you look at (or you) for 20 seconds: Regeneration II, absorption and a little toughness.
nusmp.page.book_plant.mimosa_flower_prin: Flower Princess Utopia - a garden of flowers opens round you for 14 seconds (8 blocks): up to 8 allies mend 8 percent of their health a second, a fatal wound is closed once per ally (40 percent), and foes inside are slowed.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.william_magic: Magic Warding Ash - a great ash tree stands over you for 8 seconds: a little toughness, and its branches take the enemy spells that fly within 6 blocks out of the air (up to 4 a step).
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.william_great: Great Tree Mistilteinn - world-tree roots spread 9 blocks round you for 6 seconds: up to 8 foes are held in them (slowed, 3 base damage a second) and their mana is drunk for you; the last pulse roots them.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.william_misti: Mistilteinn Blade - a blade of world-tree wood cuts a wide arc 8 blocks long: 11 base damage to up to 8 foes, and the sap that is cut mends you a little. The effect is the mod's reading: the wiki gave only the name.
nusmp.page.book_steel.klaus_piercing_lan: Blazing Piercing Lance (施貫の烈槍) - a lance of steel flies up to 29 blocks through everything in its line: 14 base damage, pushed back.
nusmp.page.book_steel.klaus_castle_wall: Steel Castle's Armored Wall (鋼城の鎧壁) - a wall of steel rises round you for 7 seconds: Resistance II, absorption, and the enemy spells that come within 4.5 blocks are stopped (up to 4 a step).
nusmp.page.book_steel.klaus_spiral_lance: Violent Spiral Lance (旋貫の激槍) - a drill of steel turns through everything on a line of 22 blocks: 16 base damage, thrown up and held for a moment.
nusmp.page.book_steel.klaus_thunder_arro: Thunder Arrow (神鳴の矢) - the union arrow of steel, lightning and wings: it crosses 40 blocks at once, pierces up to 8 foes for 20 base damage, stuns them for 1.5 seconds and cuts spells on its line. It cannot be steered, and you are slowed for 2 seconds after the shot.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.langris_archange: Archangel's Crash (大天使の撃墜) - a stroke of space that removes whatever it touches together with the space: 18 blocks, 16 base damage to up to 8 foes, and enemy spells on the line are cut away.
Archangel's Annihilation (大天使の撃滅) - three strokes of space fan out over 12 ticks, 20 blocks each, 12 base damage each to up to 8 foes per stroke. The effect is inferred from the name.
nusmp.page.book_spatial.langris_spatial_: Spatial Auto-Guard (空間魔法のオートガード) - for 12 seconds space guards you by itself: a little toughness and the enemy spells that come within 5 blocks are removed (up to 4 a step).
nusmp.page.book_light.karna_crescent_cut: Crescent Cut - three crescents of moonlight fan out from your hand, 14 blocks each, 7 base damage each. Moonlight Magic.
nusmp.page.book_light.karna_bewitching_m: Bewitching Moonlight - the moonlight settles on the one you look at and up to two foes beside it and takes hold of the body: held for 3 seconds, weakened for 6.
nusmp.page.book_light.karna_full_moon_sh: Full Moon Shell - a sphere of dark moon-mana closes round you for 6 seconds: foes within 3.8 blocks are knocked away every half second, enemy spells are stopped and you take a little less damage.
nusmp.page.book_light.karna_crescent_cut: Crescent Cut Full Moon - the shell closes and fires crescents erratically from every side: five of them over 2 seconds, 12 blocks each, 6 base damage each to up to 8 foes.
nusmp.page.book_light.karna_lunatic_cris: Lunatic Crisis - you gather the mana round the red moon for 1.5 seconds and let it go as one enormous ray of moonlight, 40 blocks long: 26 base damage to up to 8 foes, thrown back; enemy spells on the line are cut.
nusmp.page.book_storm.kaiser_area_helix: Vortex Magic: Area Helix (螺旋結界) - a huge spherical vortex turns where you aim for 8 seconds (8 blocks): up to 8 foes are dragged to its middle, slowed and cut for 3 base damage a second, and enemy spells are swallowed.
